prior_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah can now read the map's labels, the map's source is identified as Bral, and Grimny says the treasure is probably hidden at the Dragon's Lair (beat_77), which partly answers where it is. The treasure is not yet found.

Vivian's faun-wine method gives a way past the impenetrable scales (beat_48, beat_50), and Lady Hilda and Malzazarik joined (beat_62). Dunk now suspects there may be no dragon at all (beat_78). The dragon is still not killed.

Wayman renegotiated with the same goblins. They will stay in the upper rooms behind walled-off stairs instead of having the mound cleared (beat_13). The party now owes Snurk silence toward King Hogboon (beat_15).
Sir Alfred was incapacitated but not destroyed, and the party left him in the mound (beat_7, beat_10), so the danger has changed in nature but not ended. Brother Dirk calls him holy (beat_9).
Cedric and Warwick both say supplies stopped when the dragon troubles began, which partly answers why the shipments stopped.

Ingrid's night visits to Warwick were confirmed, and Sir Phidipaldi told her Warwick is not interested (beat_58), which changes the situation. Dunk's promise to help her was never released, so the thread stays open.
Dr. Uriah did neither the penance nor the donation. The goblins now intend to destroy the Barrow Mound church (beat_14), which bears on the upkeep he owes.
The party took a lot of treasure and signed it over to Cedric (beat_26) without giving Squints a pick. The promise is still owed.

new_threads.name: Robes for Brother Dirk
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah promised to return the barrow robes to the church once the dragon is defeated (beat_23), and that promise is still owed. The promise is to Dirk's church, not a means of the hunt.

new_threads.name: Cedric's promissory note
new_threads.reason: Cedric owes 975 gold for the treasure once the caravans flow again, and the note has been offered to pay the new hirelings. One deal with one counterpart.

new_threads.name: The Warwick deal
new_threads.reason: The party owes Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine and the return of his mithril shirt, and Warwick holds the lyre and plate armor as collateral. These are sides of one bargain. The shirt was wanted for the mine, not the dragon, so the thread has no parent.

new_threads.name: Protection against the dragon's poison
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi said anti-poison remedies are needed because they are hunting the dragon (beat_37), which makes this a child of the hunt. Neither Ingrid nor Vivian could provide any (beat_51).

new_threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
new_threads.reason: Dunk delivered Vivian's scent and letter to Grimny's ghost, who then ascended (beat_79, beat_81). Nothing remains owed.

new_threads.name: Who killed Grimny
new_threads.reason: Grimny believes his brother Bral killed him (beat_72), but this is unconfirmed. The fate of the other dwarves is also unknown. The question stands apart from the treasure hunt's aim.

new_threads.name: Grimny's ring
new_threads.reason: Dunk wears a magical ring that drew him to put it on, and no one knows whether it is cursed (beat_69, beat_70). Its known power to reach Grimny's ghost is now moot because the ghost has gone.

standalone_beats.reason: Ingrid's wares, including wolfsbane, witch powder and mandrake tea, are now known as a resource the party can buy.

shared_subjects.subject: Sir Brandon's magic sword, effective against evil
shared_subjects.reason: The party will next use the sword to drag it through the dragon's mouth.

shared_subjects.subject: Sir Alfred incapacitated but intact in the lower level
shared_subjects.reason: The danger itself is the subject of the Sir Alfred thread.

shared_subjects.subject: Goblins' intent to destroy the Barrow Mound church
shared_subjects.reason: It arose from the renegotiated goblin bargain.

shared_subjects.subject: The barrow robes, non-magical relics kept against the dragon
shared_subjects.reason: The robes are held under Dr. Uriah's promise to the church.

shared_subjects.subject: Squints' pick from the barrow treasure now sold to Cedric
shared_subjects.reason: The debt to Squints lives on its bargain's thread.

shared_subjects.subject: Cedric's note as payment for Malzazarik and Lady Hilda
shared_subjects.reason: The note is what the party received under the Cedric deal.

shared_subjects.subject: Whether the caravans will flow again
shared_subjects.reason: The question is about the shipments themselves, and the note's payment depends on the answer.

shared_subjects.subject: Warwick's metal shortage since the dragon appeared
shared_subjects.reason: The party acts on the shortage by bringing Warwick metal.

shared_subjects.subject: Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan and worn by Wayman
shared_subjects.reason: The shirt was received under the Warwick bargain.

shared_subjects.subject: Warwick's night visitor, who is Ingrid
shared_subjects.reason: The visits are the very matter of the Ingrid deal.

shared_subjects.subject: The Dragon's Lair's location and layout
shared_subjects.reason: The party plans to go there first to lure and kill the dragon.

shared_subjects.subject: The treasure probably hidden at the Dragon's Lair
shared_subjects.reason: Finding the treasure is the treasure map thread's aim.

shared_subjects.subject: Whether the dragon is real or Bral's ruse
shared_subjects.reason: The question is about the dragon itself.

shared_subjects.subject: Bral as the dwarf who lost the party their map
shared_subjects.reason: Bral's link to the map bears on finding the treasure.

shared_subjects.subject: The cave-in sealing the Dwarven mine
shared_subjects.reason: The cave-in most directly blocks getting metal for Warwick.

shared_subjects.subject: Grimny's ghost and its departure
shared_subjects.reason: The ghost was reached through the ring, and its departure changes what the ring does.
